overview: A full online shopping website for Mr Kipmasai Mini Mart where shoppers browse and search groceries, add items to a cart, and place delivery orders in Malaysian Ringgit.
features: Browse and search a mini mart product catalogue by category
Product detail pages with images, price in RM and stock
Shopping cart that persists across refreshes
Checkout with delivery details and order confirmation
Sign in to view your own order history
Admin area to add, edit and delete products with uploaded images
